resources.string: Experimental Qwen reference port. The existing synthetic quality gate failed (73/96). VM results are not phone performance or energy evidence. Every suggestion requires human review.

No model is bundled or downloaded by this app. Import model_q4.onnx and tokenizer.json (about 1.8 GB). Both hashes are checked before loading. Android may reclaim cached storage for an import. Model rights remain a separate review.
